name: Dong-u Shin
lead: From engineering knowledge to reliable design decisions — connecting language models, physical models, and computational mechanics.
about: I am a mechanical engineering graduate from Sunmoon University, interested in enabling AI to use reliable engineering knowledge for design and optimization.
aboutDetail: My current direction connects knowledge-grounded LLM agents, physics-guided surrogate modeling, and engineering decision support. Rather than automating every simulation, I aim to improve how design requirements, evidence, and predictions inform engineering choices.
